title: A task added from Today gets the wrong date when the owner's time zone is a day ahead of UTC
what: 1) Settings time zone Pacific/Kiritimati (UTC+14), device in any zone 2) Tasks → Today 3) type a name, Enter
expected: Expected the task due today in the owner's zone. Actual: it is saved with yesterday's date (due_date − today = −1) and lands in Overdue.
cause: Not yet traced; the quick-add default date does not come from the same owner-zone 'today' the view uses (see also the UTC-before-settings finding).
evidence: apps/web/e2e/audit/adversarial.spec.ts ADV-40 fails on desktop Chromium and webkit-iphone-15-pro

title: Digits typed quickly into the PIN screen are dropped
what: 1) /lock on desktop 2) type six digits about 15 ms apart (a paste-speed typist, a password manager, or a slow machine)
expected: Expected six dots and Unlock enabled. Actual: fewer digits are registered, Unlock stays disabled.
cause: PinPad reads `value` from a ref that is refreshed in an effect after render; two keydowns before the next commit both append to the same stale value.
evidence: e2e/02-auth.spec.ts:64 times out on firefox-desktop (every run) and on desktop Chromium under load: the 6th digit never registers, button stays disabled

title: Main-thread blocking and LCP are far from the SPEC §12 budget under mobile throttling
what: Lighthouse mobile (4× CPU, slow 4G) on the seeded instance, signed in.
expected: Expected LCP < 1.5 s and a responsive main thread. Actual: performance score 25–81; total blocking time 0.8–2.1 s on every route (up to 7.5 s on Goals in one run); LCP 7.5 s on Tasks, Focus and Settings and 3.6 s on Goals, although FCP is 0.78 s everywhere.
cause: The shell paints fast, then hydration, the persisted-cache restore and per-row motion/drag components run as long tasks; LCP waits for data-bound content.
evidence: docs/polish/data/lighthouse-before.json

title: Memory baseline: no growth trend, but WebGL resource counts cannot be observed
what: 30-minute scripted session (214 rounds over every tab).
expected: Expected a flat heap and observable GPU resource counts. Actual: heap 12.7 MB after load → 15.2 MB at 30 min, flat for the last 10 minutes (+0.1 MB while 60 more tasks entered the cache); DOM nodes and listeners constant. The scene exposes no renderer.info, so texture/geometry disposal could not be measured.
cause: No diagnostics hook for renderer statistics.
